expects.rule: The first screen says what can be rented and where (city, district, transport stop) in the headline.
Prices per formula are published (day pass, desk, private office, room per hour), with VAT stated.
One primary action: book a visit or a free test day for coworking, request a quote for a venue.
Access hours (staffed hours and member 24/7 access) and the full address are plain text.
Venues give capacities per room (seated, standing, surface in m²) and floor plans or a virtual tour.
Photographs show the actual rooms, labelled by name, rather than generic office stock images.

traits: 5 of 8 publish prices on the home page (Silversquare, Llum, Anticafe, Yellow Desk, FoundrSpace); all 5 give a day or hourly entry price, from 6 EUR an hour to 35 EUR a day.
4 of 8 have a Book a tour or Request a visit button (Silversquare, Llum, Yellow Desk, FoundrSpace); the 2 event venues use Request a quote or Organize your event.
4 of 8 show a phone number on the home page (Llum, LOFFICE, Yellow Desk, Stazione Leopolda); Silversquare, FoundrSpace and Kortrijk Xpo show none.
4 of 8 state 24/7 member access but none gives reception hours on the home page except Silversquare in its FAQ (8:30 to 17:00).
Both event venues give size figures (Stazione Leopolda 6,000 m2 and 1,850 guests; Kortrijk Xpo nearly 40,000 m2 and 6 halls) and neither publishes prices.
5 of 8 offer a language switch (Silversquare NL/FR/EN, Llum ES/EN/FR, Stazione IT/EN, Kortrijk NL/FR/EN, LOFFICE HU).

sites.name: Silversquare
sites.why: Belgian and Luxembourg coworking: headline 'Unique coworking spaces in Belgium & Luxembourg', top bar 'Book a free test day', Book a tour button, menus for Solutions and six cities, prices excl. VAT (Day Pass 35 EUR, Flex 250 EUR a month, Private Office 475 EUR, meeting rooms from 28 EUR), named meeting-room photos, NL/FR/EN.

sites.name: Llum Coworking
sites.why: Single coworking in Valencia: headline 'Coworking en Valencia', subline on light, Solicitar una visita button in the header, prices + IVA (day 25 EUR Mon-Thu 9:00-18:00, fixed desk from 205 EUR, rooms from 18 EUR an hour), street address near Xativa metro, phone and email, Google rating with 165 reviews, ES/EN/FR.

sites.name: LOFFICE
sites.why: Budapest coworking and event spaces, page in Hungarian: banner on design offices for rent with flexible terms, menu About, Services, Book!, Contact, Login, cards for loft offices, coworking, meeting and event room hire, registered-office packages; reception address, phone and email; client logos. Prices sit behind a Packages and prices link.

sites.name: Anticafe
sites.why: French cafe-coworking in Bordeaux and Strasbourg: headline 'Le pionnier francais du cafe-coworking, depuis 2013', line 'Payez le temps, pas la conso.', price 6 EUR an hour capped at 29 EUR a day with drinks included, Reserver une place button, one link per city, privatisation offers for seminars. Opening days stated, no times.

sites.name: Yellow Desk Co
sites.why: One coworking in South Yarra, Melbourne: headline 'More than just Coworking', menus Room Hire (two boardrooms, photo studio) and Workspaces, Book a tour twice, prices +GST (Flexi Pass from 40 AUD, desk 600 AUD a month, office 2,500 AUD), street address, phone, email, a long enquiry form with date and time.

sites.name: FoundrSpace
sites.why: California coworking with two sites and one coming: headline 'The future of work is hybrid', banner for the new Covina location, menus Locations, About, Events (venue hire), Perks, price grid (day pass 30 USD, seat 199 USD a month, office from 800 USD, meeting room 50 USD an hour), Book a tour per site. No street address or phone.

sites.name: Stazione Leopolda
sites.why: Event venue in a former Florence station: headline 'A unique venue in the heart of Florence, where your event comes to life', about 6,000 m2 over two buildings for up to 1,850 guests, Request a quote repeated, Virtual tour, upcoming events with dates, client testimonials, street address, phone and email, IT/EN.

sites.name: Kortrijk Xpo
sites.why: Exhibition and conference venue in West Flanders: headline 'when ideas need space', menus Calendar, Visit, Organize (spaces, meetings, catering), figures nearly 40,000 m2, 6 halls, 5 meeting rooms, Organize your event and View our calendar buttons, event cards with dates, photos of halls during fairs. No phone or email on the home page.

avoid: Prices hidden behind a 'packages and prices' link or a contact form for standard desks and day passes.
No street address on the home page of a space people must find on foot.
Room photos without the room's name, capacity or surface beside them.
A venue home page with no phone, no email and no quote form, only a Contact menu item.
'24/7 access' stated without the staffed reception hours or how a visitor gets in.
An enquiry form asking for package, room length, date and time before a first visit.
Prices quoted without saying whether VAT or GST is included.
